full_judgment: 4. The petitioners are co-sharers of the holding while opposite party No. 1 Md Mosharraf Hossain is a mere stranger purchaser and hence the petitioners are legally entitled to pre-empt the transfer in question. The petitioners deposited the consideration money of Taka 3,000.00 10% compensation thus totaling an amount of Taka 3300.00. They were not aware of the transfer and only after obtaining a certified copy of the deed of transfer on 5-12-91 they filed the Misc. Case on 1-1-92 for pre-emption and for khas possession.
